summary: Enforce remote branch lifecycle in hub CI

delivery.outcome: The governance hub's required CI rejects remote branch lifecycle drift instead of only unit-testing the validator.
nonGoals: No automatic deletion of unknown or unmerged branches
No local worktree cleanup from GitHub Actions

architecture.decision: Acquire a bounded GitHub snapshot in the existing required test job and validate it with the already canonical deterministic checker.
interfaceChanges: The existing test required check now also represents live remote branch lifecycle conformance.
architecture.rollback: Remove the live snapshot steps; CI will again test the validator without enforcing current GitHub state.

validation.evidence: The workflow wiring and snapshot contract are present.
Clean, owned, orphaned and malformed fixtures retain deterministic verdicts.
The bounded implementation diff passes the hub governance gate.
